rationale: Capped far-field proportional kick (err limited to +0.24/-0.20), gated integral (only integrates when |tgt-yf|<=0.12 with anti-windup freeze on saturation), increased measurement-damping (Kd 3->10, Dlim 0.06->0.12, slow filter 20s->32s), added overshoot-only brake Kb*(yf-tgt) when above target, kept Umax 0.70 for slow-plant rise but lowered typical cruise via ff+small P, and sped feedforward learning 250s->120s. This directly counters slow-lag overshoot: high initial push still arrives on time but P tapers early, D anticipates stored heat, integral cannot wind up far away, brake pulls power down as soon as y crosses target, ff re-learns u*~0.45.

extra.machine_card: Heater y in [0,1] (0=15C 1=75C) u in [0,1]. Nominal: first-order tau~150-160s, delay <15s, ss(u)~0.05+1.0*u, u*(0.5)~0.45, noise/quant ~0.005. Changed: gain ~0.95-1.05 unchanged, ambient ~0.05 unchanged, delay <15s unchanged, effective tau ~280-300s (~1.8-2.0x slower). Evidence: same u* but 2x settling tail and persistent 0.03 overshoot.
extra.predicted_behavior: Cold start 0.05->0.5: rise to 0.40 in ~120-150s (nominal) / ~220s (slow), peak <0.53 (vs 0.55-0.56 before), no sustained >0.525 tail, settle to 0.50+/-0.015 by ~280s nominal / ~380s slow, then stay in band. In-band after 300s >0.80 (vs 0.56-0.66), MAE <0.018 (vs 0.022-0.023), energy similar or ~5 lower due to lower cruise, zero overrides/violations.
extra.diagnosis: Same power now produces similar final level but much slower return, i.e. lag increased not gain loss. E7-E8: u=0.45 holds 0.4967 flat with slope ~0 in 240s total. Heldout v1/v3 with same mean u~0.448 holds 0.507/0.490 but needs >200s to fall from peak 0.55-0.56 (t~300s) to 0.525 (t~500s); nominal first-order with tau 159s (E1: 0.05->0.389 in 180s at u=0.5 gives tau~159s) predicts 0.55->0.525 in ~104s (ss 0.50). Observed ~200s is ~2x. Early rise rate per unit u similar (~0.004/s) and steady u* still ~0.45, so not actuator_weaker (would need higher u*) nor outflow_increased (would fall faster, need higher u*, cool faster). Initial delay still 6-20s, so pure delay unchanged. Cause is increased time constant / slower response producing saturation-induced overshoot and long tail, cutting in-band to 0.56-0.66.
